protocol_revision: V1 wider-network runs exposed missing origin reservations; retained under stage3_failed_v1. V2 fixed before new formal runs.
resource_extension: Add origin NODE occupancy at scheduled departure, selected first-edge layer, with the existing 8s buffer on each side. Common to every Stage3 method.
nature: Local prospective synthetic extension; not public preregistration

large.route_policy: all directed four-edge paths for selected OD, sorted lexically; at most four retained

baseline.objective: weighted ground delay only; structural penalties excluded
baseline.warm_start: SPC-WSR upper bound for both solvers; label warm-start-only when no improvement

statistics.test: two-sided paired Wilcoxon; one Stage3 Holm family, separate from Stage2

replay.source: Stage2 speed-bounded single_merge n100 window60 seed24 SPC-WSR
replay.frame_policy: overview at maximum active count; detail at most active UAVs within 120m of C; earliest ties
